title: Where is my order?
summary: A shipping status question. A small model should be enough.
message: Hi, this is Priya Nair (priya.nair@example.com). Could you tell me where my kettle is? It is order A-1057, and I am hoping it arrives before the weekend.

title: Damaged jacket refund
summary: Policy lookup, then a refund of the item and shipping.
message: Hello, I am Priya Nair (priya.nair@example.com). The zip on the Trail Runner jacket that arrived last week (order A-1042) is broken. I would like my money back please.

expect.label: Full refund of $138.99 issued on A-1042 (item and shipping)

title: Late order, angry VIP
summary: A platinum customer, a late delivery and a chargeback threat. Policy maths and tone both matter.
message: This is completely unacceptable. I am Elena Petrova (elena.petrova@example.com) and my espresso machine, order A-1075, was promised for 28 September and it still has not arrived. I have been a loyal customer for years. I want the shipping refunded and I expect proper compensation, otherwise I am filing a chargeback.

expect.label: Shipping fee of $24.99 refunded on A-1075

title: Refund outside the return window
summary: The customer asks for something policy does not allow. The right move is a warranty claim.
message: I am Marcus Webb (marcus.webb@example.com). The motor on my oak standing desk, order A-1061, stopped working after about six weeks. I want a full refund.

expect.label: No refund issued outside the 30-day window
Warranty claim escalated to a human

title: Address change plus an unrelated question
summary: One action the store can do and one request it cannot.
message: Hi, Marcus Webb here (marcus.webb@example.com). Please change the delivery address on order A-1088 to 14 Harbour Lane, Leeds LS1 4AB. Also, can you recommend a good tent for winter camping?

title: Missing details
summary: No order number. The agent should ask rather than guess.
message: I want to return my order.

expect.label: No refund issued without an order
